summary: Ares Strategic Income Fund, a non-traded BDC, filed an 8-K reporting unregistered sales of 297,543 Class I common shares for $8.0 million in September 2026, priced at NAV per share of $26.74 as of August 31, 2026, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation S. The same filing disclosed aggregate NAV of roughly $10.4 billion, portfolio fair value of approximately $21.8 billion, $11.9 billion of debt outstanding, 1.15x debt-to-equity (1.12x net), and monthly distributions across Class I, S and D shares. Watch for continued NAV-based share issuance and distribution coverage rather than any deal event.
